title: TrakHound Debug Host Settings
description: Settings for a Package's local debug host (trakhound.debug.json): the Instance it connects to, its credentials and the Configuration Parameters. Left out of the Package. See the Developer Guide, section 2.3.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file (for editors). Ignored by the debug host.

instanceUrl.description: The Instance the Client connects to.

apiKey.description: An API Key for the Instance (sent in the X-API-Key header).

bearerToken.description: A Bearer Token for the Instance (sent in the Authorization header).

configurationId.description: The ID of the module's Configuration (on an Instance, each Configuration has its own ID).

volumePath.description: The folder used as the module's Volume. A relative path is relative to the build output. Defaults to "volume".

parameters.description: The Configuration Parameters (as set in the module's Configuration on an Instance). Also used by 'th dev run'.

input.description: Functions only: the input Parameters the Function is run with (used when none are passed as an argument).

theme.description: Apps only: the Theme shown until one is picked.
